purpose: Define queue safety before provider activation without claiming real AI completion.
expected_flow: complete with result evidence OR fail with error evidence
recover stale claimed/processing jobs with bounded retries
acceptance: Provider outage does not consume a pending job.
A stale worker cannot leave a job permanently claimed or processing.
Retry exhaustion ends in failed with explicit evidence.
Validation does not create personal progress.
A timeout after possible browser submit performs response readback before any retry.
The same job never creates duplicate formal completion or duplicate personal mutation.

provider_preflight_contract.failure_behavior: leave job pending; do not increment attempt_no; record system health evidence only

stale_recovery_contract.below_retry_limit: return job to pending and clear claim/start timestamps
stale_recovery_contract.at_or_above_retry_limit: set failed with explicit stale_worker_max_attempts error evidence
forbidden: marking completed without provider result evidence

blocked_changes: Supabase DDL migration for stale recovery/index fix
runtime_blocker.resume_condition: runtime allows DDL or executable source writes

next_executable_fix: allow processing -> pending only for bounded stale recovery
add provider preflight before ai_job_claim_next_v1 in worker runtime

recovery_classification.opencli_exit_69_service_unavailable: provider unavailable; do not consume a pending job
recovery_classification.opencli_exit_75_temporary_failure: timeout; if submit may have happened, first read back the existing marked response; do not blindly resubmit
recovery_classification.opencli_exit_77_auth_required: provider unavailable/auth required; do not claim new work
recovery_classification.post_submit_uncertain: never auto-resubmit until existing-response readback proves the first execution did not complete
recovery_classification.pre_submit_failure: safe to retry locally within the same attempt budget
